name: Filter — loyalty tier
description: Branches pass / fail. Pass when the passenger's loyalty tier (Gold, Silver, Platinum, …) matches one of the selected tiers. Source field is restricted to fields whose name contains 'tier', 'loyalty', or 'level'.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The loyalty-tier field — pick a string field from your request whose name contains 'tier', 'loyalty', or 'level'.

params.name: literal
params.description: Which tiers should pass — type your own list, or pick from a loyalty reference table if your workspace has one.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the passenger has no tier set (e.g. non-loyalty members).
